spec.description: Granola reads like a well-kept paper notebook that happens to be software. The page is warm white and oat, with almost no chrome: no gradients, no gloss, no glow. Everything structural is a serif. Quadrant sets headlines at weight 400, from 24px section titles up to a 108px statement, with tight negative tracking that makes the large sizes feel engraved rather than shouted. Melange, a quiet text sans, carries navigation, labels, buttons and the dense notepad mock from 10px to 20px, mostly at 400 with a single 430 reserved for button copy. Colour arrives in one olive gesture: a lime card face and a deep olive pill button, drawn from the same leaf. Radii split between soft cards at 12 to 24px and full pills for actions. Shadows stay minimal and diffuse. The effect is calm, literate and unhurried: a productivity tool that looks like stationery.

dos: Set every headline in Louize with negative tracking, larger sizes get tighter spacing.
Use Signal Orange only for the primary action and the logo mark, once per view.
Place pastel surfaces (Blush Mist, Periwinkle Fog, Warm Cream, Sage Smoke) as full bleed fields behind content, never as small chips.

brief.logo: A lowercase 'mymind' wordmark in a soft rounded sans with a small circular eye mark, calm, friendly and almost a signature.
brief.color: Paper white and coral blush base, pastel card fields, ink serif text, Signal Orange for the one action.

fonts.usage: The signature: a high contrast transitional serif used for every headline, most memorably the 96px two line hero. Negative tracking tightens the big sizes so the strokes almost touch, and the italic variant adds a literary whisper to pull quotes.
Neutral grotesque for hero subheadlines and standard paragraph copy. Medium 500 appears for the smallest emphasis; almost everything stays at 400 to keep the page quiet.
Softly rounded UI face for navigation links, footer text and inline utility labels. Its round terminals match the pill radii and keep small text friendly rather than technical.

spec.layout: A single centred column capped at 1440px with an inner content width near 1100px. The hero is a giant white circle sitting inside a full bleed peach gradient, with the 96px serif headline stacked in two lines and the supporting sentence plus pill buttons underneath. Below, features alternate between full width pastel cards and large app screenshots, separated by generous 128px section gaps and 50px card padding.
spec.motion: Calm and slow. Sections and cards fade and rise with GSAP and ScrollTrigger, the dominant easing is cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1) (ease-out-expo) over 0.7s, which makes entrances feel like a slow exhale. Small hover changes use 0.2s linear, and the nav underline sweeps with 0.25s ease-in-out. Nothing bounces or overshoots.
spec.imagery: Warm, softly lit product screenshots of the app UI placed inside rounded 36px panels, plus occasional photography of paper, plants and quiet desk scenes with a peach colour grade and gentle highlight bloom. Crops are generous and centred; nothing is sharp edged or high contrast, the mood is a sunlit afternoon.

Pastel card fields, rounded panels and aspirational copy for a creative tool.

spec.agentPrompt: Build a warm, literary interface for a personal memory tool. Set the page on Paper White #ffffff with a full bleed coral to peach gradient halo and a large circular white stage behind the hero. Headlines use a high contrast serif at 40-96px with negative tracking (up to -4.2px), body uses Inter at 20px and Nunito at 16px, all near 400 weight. The only accent is Signal Orange #ff5924 on the primary pill button and logo mark. Cards are 16px rounded pastel panels in Blush Mist #fff1f1, Periwinkle Fog #e5eaf2, Warm Cream #f3f0e7 and Sage Smoke #ccd8d0 with 50px padding. Buttons are 100px pills. Motion is GSAP ScrollTrigger fades with cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1) at 0.7s.
spec.description: mymind wraps a generous white stage in a soft peach and coral halo, so the page feels like a lit room rather than a website. The hero headline is set in Louize, a high contrast serif at roughly 96px with tight -4.2px tracking, ink black on white, and it does all the emotional work. Around it, Inter at 20px and Nunito at 16-20px carry supporting copy in Slate #4a5465 and Haze #717286. Colour is used as atmosphere, not as chrome: Blush Mist #fff1f1, Periwinkle Fog #e5eaf2, Warm Cream #f3f0e7 and Sage Smoke #ccd8d0 appear as full bleed pastel fields behind rounded 16px cards. One hot accent, Signal Orange #ff5924, marks the primary action and the small circular logo mark, never competing with the type. Corners swing between fully round 100px pills and soft 16px panels; shadows are coral tinted and barely there.

brief.logo: Palabra en mayúsculas espaciadas con una estrella pequeña delante, dibujada en tinta Obsidian.
brief.color: Pila de grises cálidos, tinta Obsidian y un Signal Orange solo para el agente.

dos: Set every headline in Display at weight 400 with -0.03em tracking and a line height under 1.
Stack the three greys: Ash for the shell, Vellum for the body, Paper White for anything that floats.
Label actions and sections in Geist Mono at 11px uppercase with 0.08em tracking.
Keep marketing corners at 0px and separate surfaces with 1px Hairline borders instead of shadow.
Leave a step of tone between a card and the page, never a glow or a coloured shadow.
Reach for Signal Orange once per view, as the agent's mark.
Open sections with 112px of top padding and keep body copy in the right column of a 1440px frame.

brief.logo: A letterspaced uppercase wordmark preceded by a small eight-point star glyph, drawn in Obsidian ink.
brief.color: Warm grey paper from Vellum to Paper White, Obsidian ink, one Signal Orange for the agent.
brief.voice: Second person, short plain declaratives, quiet confidence, ending on "The things you kept, back when you need them."
brief.motion: Reveals drift in slowly, hover snaps. Scroll animation with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) at 0.4s.
brief.imagery: Almost none in the hero, type carries the page. Lower down, flatly cropped reference thumbnails sit on Paper White cards.
brief.typography: A high-contrast serif at 400 only, clamped huge, Geist body, Geist Mono caps labels.
brief.iconography: Small filled geometric glyphs in Obsidian ink, one hairline outline at 1.25px, no library detected.

donts: Do not bold a headline or load a second serif weight; Display only ever appears at 400.
Do not add gradients, glows, glass or coloured shadows; the palette is flat paper and ink.
Do not round cards, buttons or inputs on the marketing page.
Do not set body copy in Obsidian or add tracking to the serif; Headline stays the darkest thing.
Do not use Signal Orange for a button fill, a link or a heading; it belongs to the agent mark.
Do not mix Geist Mono into paragraphs; it is for labels, nav and section numbers only.
Do not move elements on hover: colour changes at 0.1s, entrances fade and drift at 0.4s.

fonts.usage: A single high-contrast serif, loaded as display and used for every heading on the page. Weight 400 is the only weight, so the hierarchy comes from size and tracking rather than boldness. The optical size is large: 132px at a 0.88 line height, with -0.03em tracking pulling the words into a solid engraved block.

The working text face: lead paragraphs, card contents, list metadata, chips. Nearly all of it is weight 400 in Graphite; weight 500 appears once, on the outlined in-app button. Body copy sits at 17px / 1.55 with -0.01em tracking, small enough to stay subordinate to the serif.

The interface voice: navigation, buttons, section numbers and step labels, always uppercase at 11px with 0.08em tracking. It never appears in running prose. Its even rhythm is what makes even a plain invite button read as a piece of machinery.

spec.layout: One 1440px frame with 40px side gutters. The hero breaks into two columns: the headline occupies the left two thirds at clamp(52px, 9.2vw, 148px), while the description and its button sit in a right column starting past the midpoint. Sections open with 112px of top padding and 48px below, blocks are separated by 20px and 24px vertical rhythm, and everything is left aligned. The result is an asymmetric editorial spread rather than a centred landing page.
spec.motion: Deliberately split between snap and drift. Interactive colour and transform resolve in 0.1s to 0.15s with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); entrances and reveals take 0.4s to 0.6s with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) and are scroll triggered. A Three.js canvas carries the heaviest movement, while text blocks only fade and travel a short distance. Tokens: tap 0.1s, quick 0.15s, settle 0.25s, travel 0.4s, drift 0.6s.
spec.imagery: Mostly empty and type-led, with 34 images loaded and 4 of them large: flatly cropped reference thumbnails on Paper White cards, plus one canvas. No video, no full-bleed photography and no colour grading, so the page's warmth comes entirely from the grey paper.

similar.why: A private archive of saved references, grey paper surfaces, mono labels and an unglamorous tone.
Image saving presented with oversized restrained type and a near monochrome palette.
Editorial headlines over a near-white shell with small uppercase mono caps for navigation.
A confident custom serif at large sizes with a lot of quiet space around it.

spec.tagline: daylit grey archive of personal taste
spec.elevation: Depth is drawn, not cast: three greys stack (Ash, Vellum, Paper White) and 1px Hairline borders do the separation. Shadows exist only on floating cards, from a five-step scale. elev-1: 0 1px 1px -0.5px #23201a0a, 0 2px 3px -1.5px #23201a0a. elev-2: 0 1px 1px -0.5px #23201a0d, 0 3px 5px -2px #23201a0d, 0 7px 12px -4px #23201a0d. elev-4 adds an inset 0 1px 0 0 #fff9 edge. On dark surfaces the whole system collapses to one deep shadow, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 0 24px 60px -20px, behind white at 10% borders.

components.name: Header
components.role: A single thin row holding the wordmark left and mono navigation right.

spec.agentPrompt: Build on a warm grey paper stack: #efefef page over a #e9e9e9 shell, #fafafa for anything that floats, #1a1a1a as ink, #666666 for body copy, #e3e3e3 for every 1px border. Headlines: one high-contrast serif at weight 400 only, clamp(52px, 9.2vw, 148px), line height 0.88, tracking -0.03em. Body: Geist 17px / 1.55 in #666666. Labels: Geist Mono 11px uppercase, 0.08em tracking. Buttons are square: #1a1a1a fill, #fafafa mono caps, no radius, no shadow. One accent, #ff5f00, for the agent mark. Colour transitions 0.1s, reveals 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).
spec.description: Trove reads like a printed archive that happens to be a web app. The page sits on a stack of warm greys, #efefef body over a #e9e9e9 shell, with Paper White #fafafa reserved for anything that floats, so depth comes from tone and 1px #e3e3e3 hairlines rather than shadow. Almost everything is set in a custom high-contrast serif at a single weight: 400. It runs at 132px with -0.03em tracking and a 0.88 line height, so the headline feels engraved rather than shouted, and its ink is #1a1a1a, never pure black. Geist carries body copy at 17px in #666666, keeping the headline the darkest object on screen. Geist Mono, 11px uppercase with 0.08em tracking, holds nav, buttons and section numbers, the only place interface language appears. One chromatic accent, #ff5f00, marks the agent. Corners are square, motion is short, and empty grey does as much work as the type.

brief.logo: Sin símbolo: el nombre va dentro de la frase, en tipografía de texto, minúsculas, con punto final y un cursor que escribe.
brief.color: Grises casi blancos, una sola voz grafito y un azul eléctrico escondido.
brief.voice: Primera persona discreta, llana y algo irónica. "This is perfolios, a hand-picked directory of the most beautiful personal sites on the internet."
brief.motion: Rápido y de interruptor: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) a 0.15s.
brief.imagery: Capturas de portfolios en abanico, como una mano de cartas, cada una un sitio real. Paletas mezcladas, del blanco al azul profundo, al casi negro y al marrón cálido, con luz suave y sombras largas.
brief.typography: Public Sans en peso 500 para todos los tamaños, Geist Mono solo para contar cosas.
brief.iconography: Iconos de contorno a 16px, trazo de 1,75-2px, geométricos y de esquinas redondeadas.

dos: Set every text run, headings included, in Public Sans weight 500 at 15px/1.5; hierarchy is colour, not size.
Use Geist Mono 12px only for quantities, counters and keyboard hints.
Reserve Obsidian for the current or actionable item, keep copy in Graphite and dormant labels in Ash.
Build surfaces from shadow rings (0 0 0 .5px Hairline, 0 .5px 0 Raised White inset) instead of borders.
Keep controls between 28px and 36px tall with 10-12px radii, and full pills for anything floating.
Transition colour in 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); anything slower reads as decoration.
Pop one Raised White surface above the Paper ground whenever something needs to detach, as the card fan does.

brief.logo: No symbol: the name is inlined into the sentence in body type, lowercase with a trailing period and a blinking typing caret.
brief.color: Near-white greys with one graphite voice and a hidden electric blue.
brief.voice: Quiet first person, plain and a little wry. "This is perfolios, a hand-picked directory of the most beautiful personal sites on the internet."
brief.imagery: Portfolio screenshots fanned like a hand of cards, each thumb a real site. Mixed palettes, from white pages to deep blue, near-black and warm brown, lit softly and dropped on long shadows.
brief.typography: Public Sans at weight 500 for every size, Geist Mono only to count things.
brief.iconography: Small outline glyphs at 16px, roughly 1.75-2px strokes, geometric with rounded terminals.

donts: Never introduce a display size, a bold weight or a second text colour for emphasis.
Do not paint surfaces with Signal Blue; it exists for selection and focus only.
Avoid hard 1px borders and flat grey cards, edges come from 0.5px rings and inset highlights.
Do not mix radii inside one family: pills for floating actions, 8-12px for inline controls.
No filled or saturated icons beyond the two solid toggles; glyphs stay 16px outline.
Do not add a display face for headings or numbers, the system has exactly two families.

fonts.usage: Everything: body copy, headings, controls, chips. Weight 500 does all the work, there is one 400 sample in the whole page, so nothing is ever bold and nothing is ever regular.
Only counters and metadata: the portfolio count, the live badge, the keyboard slash hint in the search field. It gives numbers a machine-read honesty without turning the page technical.

colors.name: Paper
colors.role: Page ground for the whole directory. Slightly warm, never pure white, so raised surfaces can float above it.

colors.name: Raised White
colors.role: Only for lifted things: floating toolbars, pill buttons, and the portfolio thumbnails in the fan. Always paired with a ring shadow rather than a border.

colors.name: Fog
colors.role: Recessed control surface: search field, inactive segmented tabs, the visual cue that something is meant to be typed into or stepped on.

colors.name: Cloud
colors.role: Weightless fill for inline chips and tags, the lightest surface that still separates a word from the page.

colors.name: Hairline
colors.role: Not a border but a 0.5px ring and inset highlight, the entire edge language of the interface.

colors.name: Obsidian
colors.role: Reserved for what is current or actionable: the active filter, the theme icon in use, links. Never used for long copy.

colors.name: Graphite
colors.role: The reading voice. Body copy, headings, chips and icon glyphs all default here; it is the page's normal temperature.

colors.name: Ash
colors.role: Dormant text: unselected filters, sponsor label, placeholders and metadata. The tone that says not yet, not now.

colors.name: Signal Blue
colors.role: The only chroma in the system, defined for selection and focus. It renders almost nowhere; treat it as an accent on demand, not a surface.

spec.layout: A single narrow column on Paper, roughly 720px of content, with a fixed left rail of filters. Vertical rhythm is generous: 80px above the fold content, 48px between the intro and the counter, 40px before the search block. Almost nothing is boxed; separation comes from 0.5px hairlines and 8-12px of breathing room rather than containers.
spec.motion: One dominant easing carries state: colour 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), with opacity 0.2s on the same curve for appearing elements. The card fan and a handful of transforms use a slower 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), and the tokens define a deliberate in-out cubic-bezier(.645.045.355, 1) for anything that moves both ways. Scroll animations are on, but they stay at the fade level.
spec.imagery: Eight photographs, all screenshots of real portfolio sites rather than stock: white editorial pages, a saturated blue project sheet, near-black photo work, warm brown. They are cropped to page proportions and fanned at slight rotations like prints in a hand, each with a long soft shadow so the group reads as a physical object.
spec.tagline: quiet near-white index of hand-picked sites
spec.elevation: Two shadows do all the work. Raised: 0 .5px 0 #fff inset, 0 0 0 .5px #e0e0e0, 0 -.5px 0 #d0d0d0 inset, 0 2px 5px #00000010. Lifted: 0 0 0 .5px #00000014, 0 1px 0 #fff inset, 0 12px 32px -8px #00000030. There is no other depth cue.

spec.agentPrompt: You are extracting the design system of directoryyy.com (perfolios). Follow the measured JSON for values and the screenshot for judgement. Write in English except the Spanish sheet.
spec.description: A directory that behaves like a well-kept notebook. Everything sits on Paper with hairline rings instead of borders, so surfaces read as pressed sheets rather than panels. The page never raises its voice: paragraphs, headings and labels all run at 15px Public Sans weight 500, and hierarchy comes only from tone, Obsidian for what is live, Graphite for what is read, Ash for what is dormant. Geist Mono appears solely to count things. Colour is largely withheld, a grey ramp from Paper to Obsidian plus one electric blue defined for selection that the calm rarely shows. Controls are small, pill-like and float on soft inset-lit shadows rather than outlines. The single flourish is photographic: portfolio screenshots fanned like a hand of cards, each thumb carrying the weight of a printed sheet. Motion stays minimal, a 0.15s colour fade for state and one slow eased transform for the fan.

brief.voice: Segunda persona segura y directa, culta en diseño sin jerga: «Email marketing that's different by design».

Collapse line height to 1.0 for anything 24px and above, and apply -0.02em tracking.

spec.description: Flodesk is a warm paper world with a single black pen. The page sits on #F8F8F5, a barely-warm off-white, and almost all type is #111110 set in one self-hosted family, Flodesk Sans, whose 500 weight does every headline and every button label while 400 handles paragraphs. Nothing is bold; hierarchy comes from size and tracking, from a 64px display down to a 12px caption, all with a consistent -0.02em optical tightening and line heights that collapse to 1.0 at headline sizes. Radii are generous and rounded: 24px editorial cards, 100px pills for every action, circles for icon buttons. Colour arrives only in surfaces, a rotating set of muted pastels and deep jewel fields (dusty blue, olive sand, maize, lavender, oxblood) that hold product screenshots and short feature copy. There are no shadows and no visible borders; separation is made by the card fill alone. Motion is minimal and quick, mostly opacity fades around 0.2s, with Swiper driving the carousels.

brief.voice: Dry, utilitarian, second person, short labels and CTAs; "Sign up to keep exploring similar elements and save the ones you love."

brief.imagery: Dense grid of small square artwork stills and looping video, flat saturated colour on plain grounds, tightly cropped, no grading or grain.

spec.layout: A three-column archive view on a white field: a narrow left rail of stacked 3px thumbnail tiles, a large centred artwork block, and a right metadata column separated by vertical hairlines. A 56px header holds a dotted mark, three nav links at the left, a centred pill search, and log in plus Sign up at the right. Gutters are 32px everywhere, the grid below runs full-bleed with no max-width, and rhythm comes from 4px micro gaps between chips rather than from whitespace blocks.
spec.motion: Deliberately switch-like: interface transitions complete in under a tenth of a second, so colour and outline changes read as state flips rather than animation. The dominant curve is cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) at about 0.1s, applied to color, outline-width and transform. Scroll-triggered loading exists for the endless grid, but nothing eases, bounces or lingers.
spec.imagery: Dense mosaic of small square artwork stills and looping video, all flat saturated colour on plain grounds and cropped tight to the graphic. There is no photography, no grading and no grain: the content is the graphic itself, so the white page acts as a light gallery wall.

spec.agentPrompt: Build a white archive interface: full-bleed #ffffff, 32px gutters, no max-width. Use one grotesque family at weights 400 and 500 only, sizes from 12px meta to a 26px heading, letter spacing about -2% from 12px up. Ink is #0d0d0d, secondary #5a5a5a, muted #919191. Draw all structure with a 1px #0000001f border, never a shadow, except floating overlays which get 0 6px 44px rgba(0,0,0,0.15). Pill every interactive element, round image tiles to 3px and floating cards to 24px. Keep transitions near-instant with cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Let colour come only from the artwork.
spec.description: Cosmos is a white-walled archive: a full-bleed #ffffff canvas, a 56px header, and a single restrained typeface, cosmosOracle, set at 400 and 500 only. Nothing is bold. Hierarchy is built from size (12px meta up to 26px display) and from grey (Obsidian #0d0d0d, Graphite #5a5a5a, Ash #919191) rather than from weight. Space stays generous and even: 32px page gutters, 16px card padding, 4px micro gaps. Depth is not shadow but a 12% black hairline, #0000001f, drawn at 1px around every pill, chip and panel; only floating overlays lift, with a soft 44px blur. Radii split cleanly into three jobs: full pills for anything interactive, 3px for the dense thumbnail rail, 24px for the floating panel. The only saturated colour arrives through the artwork itself, a flat electric periwinkle #6364f9 against the white, so the chrome stays quiet and the pictures do the shouting.

expect.typography: Headlines in Louize at 400, never bold, and never Quadrant. Everything else in Inter at 400; dates and card metadata in Geist Mono at 500, 12px. Hierarchy from size and grey value only.
